# Microservice Data Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Microservices

## Overview

Manages data in microservice architectures with database-per-service pattern, event sourcing, and CQRS for data consistency

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [microservice-data-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
microservice-data-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@microservice-data-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement database-per-service pattern
- Design event sourcing for state management
- Build CQRS for separated read/write models
- Implement eventual consistency patterns

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Database per Service**: Data isolation pattern for microservices
- **Event Sourcing**: Event-based state management
- **CQRS**: Command Query Responsibility Segregation
